summary: Learn HL7 FHIR for health data exchange with hands-on mapping, profiles, APIs, and implementation planning. Enroll for practical interoperability skills.
lede: HL7 FHIR training covers how healthcare data and integration professionals design practical data exchanges across systems. Participants model resources, map source data, draft profiles, analyze RESTful APIs, and check terminology and conformance requirements. The course also supports implementation planning through exchange-pattern design, security and consent considerations, and stakeholder and deployment-risk mapping.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with healthcare data, integration, or digital health delivery and need a practical FHIR workflow they can use immediately.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, basic spreadsheet capability, and the ability to review sample FHIR resources in JSON format. Participants should bring a willingness to work through exchange scenarios, profile drafts, and mapping exercises using healthcare data examples.
